conditions: The licensee distributes the Source form of Derivative Works under section 4.
The listed notices appeared in the Work's Source and pertain to at least one part of the Derivative Works.
limitations: This claim addresses retention in distributed derivative Source. A duty to deliver Source is a separate question.
The upstream NOTICE attribution condition in section 4(d) and the license copy required by section 4(a) have separate triggers.
Whether a particular notice pertains to a remaining part depends on the facts of the works and distribution.

triggers: The ASF corrects or replaces the applicable clause, definitions, or cited edition.
The exact source representation, cited byte ranges, or scoped proposition changes.

statement: When a licensee distributes the Source form of Derivative Works under Apache License 2.0 section 4, section 4(c) requires retaining in that distributed Source all copyright, patent, trademark, and attribution notices from the Work's Source that pertain to at least one part of those Derivative Works.
